name: Dr. Ishvarya Ramasubramanian
bio: Dr. Ishvarya Ramasubramanian, founder of Aura Academia, is a highly experienced educator specialising in Medical Sciences and Chemistry. With 15+ years of teaching expertise, she has guided countless students to success in NEET and board examinations through her clear, concept-driven approach. Her visual-learning methods make complex biochemistry and organic chemistry both engaging and exam-ready. In recognition of her contribution to education, she was conferred an Honorary Doctorate by the Federation of Economic Development Association (FEDA).
achievements: Honorary Doctorate conferred by the Federation of Economic Development Association (FEDA)
15+ years of teaching excellence in Chemistry and Biology
Trained numerous NEET qualifiers
Expert in Medical Sciences and Chemistry education

name: Sharanya Senthil Prabhu
bio: Sharanya Senthil Prabhu is the first point of contact for families at Aura Academia. From enquiries and enrolment to timetables and progress updates, Sharanya makes sure every student's journey at Aura is smooth, supported, and successful — from the first visit to exam day.
achievements: First point of contact for students and parents
Manages enrolment, class schedules, and parent communication
Committed to student welfare and a smooth learning experience

name: Shaik Shafee
bio: Shaik Shafee is a seasoned Physics educator with 15+ years of experience. His deep understanding of Physics concepts and mastery of exam strategy has helped students excel in JEE, NEET, and board examinations consistently. He is renowned for turning abstract physics concepts into clear, exam-winning strategies.
achievements: 15+ years of Physics teaching excellence
Expert in JEE and NEET Physics preparation
Known for making complex concepts accessible and exam-ready

name: Gaurav Vinod Namjoshi
role: Expert in Higher Mathematics (Grades 9–12) & Extended Learning
bio: Gaurav Vinod Namjoshi is a highly experienced Mathematics educator and academic leader with over 23 years in teaching, curriculum development and student mentoring. He currently heads a Mathematics department for Grades 9–12 and holds an M.Sc. in Mathematics and a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.). At Aura Academia he leads higher-grade and extended-learning Mathematics, simplifying complex concepts, building analytical thinking and helping students achieve academic excellence through innovative, student-centric teaching.
achievements: 23+ years in teaching, academic leadership and educational management
Consistently achieved 100% Board Examination results for Grades 10 and 12 since 2013–14
Mentored students into prestigious Medical and Engineering colleges in India (an average of 5 per batch, 2014–2025)
Guided an average of 6 students per batch into leading Law colleges, including National Law Universities
Mentored a student who qualified through the SAT and completed Engineering at Troy University, USA
Developed Mathematics coursebooks, worksheets and structured learning resources for Grades 8–12

name: Yogeswari Natarajan
bio: Yogeswari Natarajan is a Mathematics tutor with an M.Sc. and M.Phil. in Mathematics and 10 years of teaching experience, including 8 years in school academics and 2 years as an Assistant Professor. She leads foundation Mathematics for Grades 8, 9 and 10 at Aura Academia and is passionate about helping students understand Mathematics through simple and effective teaching methods.
achievements: 8 years of experience in school academics in Mathematics
2 years of experience as an Assistant Professor
Helped students improve their mathematical skills and academic performance

name: Meena
bio: Meena is an enthusiastic Science educator with 10 years of experience. Her engaging teaching style and thorough understanding of foundational science concepts make her a favourite among students building their science base. She specialises in making science fun, relatable, and deeply understood.
achievements: 10 years of dedicated Science teaching
Specialist in foundational and applied science for Grades 8–10
Known for engaging and interactive teaching methods

name: Rithik Tatia
bio: Rithik Tatia brings a strong science background to Aura Academia, with a Master's degree in Pharmacology and Chemistry and 3+ years of teaching experience. As a Support Teacher, Rithik works alongside our subject faculty to reinforce classroom learning — running doubt-clearing sessions, guiding students through practice papers, and giving extra attention to those who need it most. A patient, step-by-step approach helps students turn difficult Chemistry and Biology topics into concepts they can explain with confidence.
specializations: Master's Degree in Pharmacology and Chemistry
achievements: 3+ years of teaching and academic support experience
Postgraduate expertise in Pharmacology and Chemistry
Runs regular doubt-clearing and revision sessions for Grades 8–12
Helps students sharpen exam technique through guided practice papers
